entities.name: Hugo Barrantes Ureña
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Hugo Barrantes Ureña was a Costa Rican Roman Catholic prelate. He was bishop of Puntarenas from 1998 to 2002 and the archbishop of San José de Costa Rica from 2002 to 2013. Barrantes Ureña died on 28 September 2024, at the age of 88.

entities.summary: Hugo Barrantes Ureña was a Costa Rican Roman Catholic prelate. He was bishop of Puntarenas from 1998 to 2002 and the archbishop of San José de Costa Rica from 2002 to 2013. Barrantes Ureña died on 28 September 2024, at the age of 88.
